purpose: Reviewed administrative payload template; never loaded automatically at startup. Supply provider credentials only in the authorized administrative session.
publication_order: Resolve and bind the canonical OpenAI vendor internal_id, then register the exact routing alias without modifying gpt-6-luna.
Create the source with status=2 (manually disabled), then read back its public ID.
Update that source with the channel_provider_cost_prices below; channel creation alone does not persist cost rows.
Publish sell_price through PUT /api/pricing/sell_prices and verify the pricing registry and catalog.
Probe the Decisions endpoint, then enable only the new source through its status endpoint and verify token-scoped discovery.

model_registration.description_en: OpenAI Decisions: ordered predicate, choice and score questions. Lazu launch limits: 8192 estimated text tokens, 64 questions and 4 inline images.
model_registration.description_zh: OpenAI 判别：按顺序返回命题、选择和评分结果。Lazu 首发限制为 8192 个估算文本 token、64 题、4 张内嵌图片。

required_bindings.model_registration.vendor_id: Resolve the canonical OpenAI vendor and set its positive internal_id before registration; maker alone does not enforce vendor-scoped authorization.

price_units.model_registration.official_input_price: USD per token; 0.0000001 equals USD 0.10 per million tokens.
